name: Amber Kearnen
summary: In Westfall, Amber Kearnen watches the Defias Brotherhood for SI:7. From cover, she tracks their unlawful activity for Master Mathias Shaw.

sections.title: Eyes on the Tower
sections.body: Far from Stormwind Keep, Amber Kearnen scouts for SI:7 in Westfall. She watches an abandoned tower occupied by the Defias Brotherhood. Master Mathias Shaw directs her work. Kearnen briefs covert operatives sent to stop Defias threats and gather intelligence across the contested countryside.

sections.title: A Deadly Assignment
sections.body: Amber Kearnen watches Klaven Mortwake, a Defias sheltered in the tower southeast of Sentinel Hill. After weeks of keeping watch, she briefs infiltrating rogues on the strange, inhuman guards that arrived with a shipment from Duskwood. She sends them to steal the tower key, enter the tower, and learn what lies in the Duskwood chest, including Klaven's journal. Her patience and careful notes aid the Crown's covert operations against the Defias.

faq.answer: Amber Kearnen works for SI:7, Stormwind's elite intelligence division. As a field agent and scout, she tracks Defias activity in Westfall.

faq.q: Where can Amber Kearnen be found?
faq.answer: Amber Kearnen keeps watch in the wilds of Westfall, near the abandoned Alliance watchtower occupied by the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What is her connection to Mathias Shaw?
faq.answer: Amber Kearnen answers directly to Master Mathias Shaw, the leader of SI:7. Shaw sends fellow agents to her in Westfall to learn what she knows about Defias activity there.

faq.q: What role does she play in Klaven's Tower?
aliases: what does she do at the tower
faq.answer: Amber Kearnen watches the tower held by Klaven Mortwake. She briefs Alliance rogues sent by SI:7 on how to slip inside, evade Defias guards, and recover Klaven's journal.

angles.text: As an Alliance rogue, you can rely on Agent Kearnen as your field contact while planning your infiltration of Klaven's Tower.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Kearnen as Stormwind's covert agent in Westfall. She works against the Defias Brotherhood without alarming the populace.
